_readme: Nominal/target values and risk zones for the Portfolio Health gauges. These are starting points based on common diversification/risk guidelines, not your stated goals - edit freely (ask Claude to adjust during a chat session).

cashPercent.note: This portfolio runs many cash-secured puts, which need cash collateral - so 'cash' here isn't idle, it's largely CSP collateral. Zones are wider than a typical buy-and-hold guideline for that reason.

topPositionPercent.note: Common single-stock concentration guideline: keep any one position under ~10% of the portfolio.

topCategoryPercent.note: Common sector/theme concentration guideline: keep any one theme under ~30% of the portfolio.

incomeYieldPercent.note: Annualized income run-rate as % of total portfolio value. Generic income-portfolio reference range, not a stated personal goal.

assignmentRiskPercent.note: % of open cash-secured puts currently in-the-money (assignment risk). Lower is more comfortable.
